zz_idle_upper_bound_record.label: idle-ZZ, angle 2x Deviation 34 convention (upper bound)
zz_idle_upper_bound_record.note: the idle rule rotates each idle-idle coupler by rzz(2 pi J tau) = rzz(zeta tau), zeta = 2 pi J; Deviation 34 fixes the pair unitary as exp(-i zeta tau/4 ZZ) = rzz(zeta tau/2), weight sin^2(zeta tau/2), so these rows carry twice the angle (about 4x the rerouted weight per pair and layer) and every ZZ-on shift is an upper bound

zz_model.rule: rzz(phi) on every coupler of the cone during the 400 ns dial idle, phi = 2 pi J tau (= zeta tau) with the signed per-edge J of the raw backend properties (fallback: median |J|); applied only when both ends idle (non-reset branch); see docs/PAULIPROP.md
